decision: Retain executable-torque filtering as an opt-in simulation baseline. Do not promote a complete transfer controller; obtain contact/actuator/estimator measurements before hardware validation.
best_supported_non_RL_variant: Existing BoxFDDP plus executable-torque cone projection from 4 s; unchanged original staged geometry and contact membership.
required_checkpoint_work_remaining: Final artifact/link and synthesis consistency review; no rollouts needed

questions.result: Executable-torque filtering reduces pulse left-sole displacement 78.460 to 0.304 mm, contact loss 210 to 0 ms, loaded slip 0.5177 to 0.0091 m/s and estimated sole residual 3.638 to 0.055 mm. Reanchoring changes state and wrench by zero with foot gains [0,50].
questions.resolved: Reanchoring alone is ineffective for this plan; initial executable-force constraints improve this nominal/pulse comparison.
questions.unresolved: Sticking dynamics cannot predict sliding or lift. Initial cone feasibility does not persist across the command interval. Fallback remains unexercised.

questions.result: Five CAD regions agree with collision boundaries within 0.165 mm, but only 2/18 saved witnesses belong to those small regions. Seven wrist-box witnesses are 8.637–23.515 mm from same-body CAD. After geometry correction, neither elbow–forearm nor forearm–wrist passes selection or reserved-target screens. Selected-body support minima are 182.21/0 N at x=1.06 m and 43.90/0 N at x=0.98 m.
questions.resolved: Body identity and force location invalidate the old site-only certification; two physical strategies were compared with reserved validation.
questions.unresolved: No admissible selection benefit. Forearm–wrist receives unselected wrist-roll support averaging 107.89/71.07 N. CAD extent does not establish load capacity.

questions.result: A consistent translation/yaw preserves predicted forces within 8.04e-11 N and first torque within 1.35e-12 N m. A base-only 10 mm error changes force by 7.009 N and first torque by 0.01883 N m. Four scene mismatch checks reject inconsistent references.
questions.resolved: Frame conversion and relative-scene consistency pass at the tested 35-node hold state, including nonzero-velocity conversion.
questions.unresolved: Known-transform adapter does not estimate base bias. Synthetic seed-17 base bias and ideal joint/velocity channels do not validate a deployed estimator, drift, delay or slip dependence.

questions.result: Added velocity cost reduces first-contact wrist speed 0.700 to 0.083 m/s and saturated startup samples 165 to 5. Startup acceleration remains 223.63 versus 226.12 rad/s², while left-sole excursion increases 18.80 to 24.35 mm. Fixed-position startup still reaches 175.62 rad/s². Best force-filter p95 is 24.22/23.96 ms against 20 ms.
questions.resolved: Velocity regularization improves contact arrival but fails the combined acceleration/sole-motion criterion; initialization contributes to acceleration.
questions.unresolved: Supported handover and deadline-aware execution remain untested. No same-condition measurement explains the approximately 90 s hardware maneuver. Earlier unlabelled 3x clips were replaced by 1x clips.

questions.result: A +20 mm target at 4 s produces 8.37 mm hand-x movement in the first 0.5 s; error decreases 27.39 to 18.96 mm. Nominal command-phase reach RMS is 19.72 mm, pulse RMS 187.71 mm. Brace onset is 2.380 s and original reach onset 2.402 s.
questions.resolved: Combined position/velocity/feedforward commands reconstruct simulated actuator torque within 6.4e-14 N m; a small target update executes.
questions.unresolved: The 20 mm target starts within the 30 mm reach screen, so zero acquisition delay is uninformative. Larger commands, height changes and hardware tracking are unmeasured.

questions.result: Scheduled nominal recovery passes at 8.530 s, 3.330 s after request. Pulse recovery fails by 9 s with 8.424 mm sole motion and 13.555 N renewed gripper load. A first-command guard produces identical motion. Motion dwell reduces pulse sole motion to 1.306 mm but both gated conditions fail; nominal final table load is 54.799 N.
questions.resolved: Feasible first-command force and low estimated motion are each insufficient release criteria under these tests.
questions.unresolved: Contact-aware unloading, abort-to-support, recovery after 9 s and feasibility of the entire return path remain unperformed.

questions.result: On 100 nominal and 75 reserved pulse transitions, known servo evolution improves angular/joint-velocity residual over 2 ms frozen torque by 4.87%/12.18%, failing the requirement that both improve by at least 10%. Previous commands violate model cones at 75/100 and 57/75 observed endpoints.
questions.resolved: Command/integration and contact feasibility are prerequisites to attributing residuals to physical parameters; the prerequisite branch is complete.
questions.unresolved: No physical-parameter fitting, online model update, scenario MPC or adapted closed-loop comparison was performed. Hardware uncertainty ranges remain unidentified.

required_hardware_data.measurement: Time-synchronized issued position, velocity and feedforward commands; joint encoders; current or torque; send/receive timestamps and controller duration. Include samples inside each 20 ms command (simulation scoring used 2 ms). Record supported initialization and actuator saturation.
required_hardware_data.purpose: Separate command evolution, lag, tracking and transport delay; set measured motion limits.

required_hardware_data.measurement: Identify actual loaded wrist-roll, wrist-yaw, forearm and gripper surfaces in body coordinates; measure table-relative clearance and normal/tangential load through loading and release. Measure loaded footprint, sole/table friction onset and compliance under known loads; record deployed asset hashes.
required_hardware_data.purpose: Validate force locations and moment arms, unloading criteria and physical parameter ranges.

required_hardware_data.measurement: Synchronize raw odometry, fused base pose/velocity and joint estimates with independent base and sole motion, table pose and calibration transforms during stance and slip.
required_hardware_data.purpose: Measure relative frame bias, drift, latency and stationary-foot estimator failure without feeding ground truth to control.

required_hardware_data.measurement: Timestamp owner-supervised command, brace, reach, release and stable recovery; log interventions, contacts and independent sole motion with labelled 1x video and simulation-equivalent criteria.
required_hardware_data.purpose: Explain maneuver duration and measure command/recovery success on the actual robot.

remaining_proposed_experiments.experiment: Contact-aware gripper/wrist unloading with a planned clearance path, compared with scheduled release on the same nominal/pulse tasks and 9 s deadline.
remaining_proposed_experiments.falsification: Reject if nominal table load remains above 5 N, disturbed recovery misses the original criteria, or motion/support worsens. Simulation thresholds require hardware calibration.

remaining_proposed_experiments.experiment: Constrain known servo evolution over each command interval, retaining initial torque filtering as baseline; score every physical substep and next estimated endpoint.
remaining_proposed_experiments.falsification: Reject if interval force violations or contact loss persist, reach worsens beyond the existing 5 mm allowance, or full controller latency exceeds 20 ms.

remaining_proposed_experiments.experiment: Re-solve from a measured supported handover after foot load and velocity settle; compare the original approach and velocity correction at identical initialization.
remaining_proposed_experiments.falsification: Persistent acceleration near 224 rad/s² rejects contact acquisition as a sufficient explanation; preserve reach and sole motion.

remaining_proposed_experiments.experiment: After contact and command prerequisites pass, fit one identifiable physical parameter or select two or three models using earlier transitions; reserve a separate measured condition.
remaining_proposed_experiments.falsification: Reject without lower reserved prediction error and task improvement at the same observation path, or if full latency exceeds 20 ms. No arbitrary uncertainty grid.
